# PSP Consultancy

> Business and financial advisory practice headquartered in Ahmedabad, India, with affiliated offices in Mumbai, Delhi, Jaipur and Indore.

## About

PSP Consultancy advises founders, developers, NRIs and growing businesses on Income Tax, GST, FEMA and RERA matters, Virtual CFO services, outsourcing, and India market entry. PSP Consultancy is a separate entity from PSP & Associates, an affiliate Chartered Accountancy firm registered with the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI). Audit and statutory certification work is carried out by PSP & Associates, not by PSP Consultancy.

## Services

- Income Tax advisory and representation before tax authorities
- GST registration, compliance and input tax credit review
- RERA advisory for real estate developers and investors
- FEMA and cross-border advisory, including FDI/ODI structuring
- Virtual CFO — financial review, budgeting, forecasting, investor reporting
- Outsourcing — bookkeeping, payroll, MIS reporting
- India business entry — entity setup, structuring, regulatory approvals
